I found no 2021 AGI forecast from Shane Legg that I could check on a page I opened, so the candidate list is empty.

- **A likely 2021 statement I couldn't verify:** The searches turned up a reply he posted on X dated 24 August 2021. He was answering a post Abeba Birhane made on 21 August 2021 that quoted an earlier comment of his. In the reply he seems to call that comment "just a comment I made in an interview", and to give 50% odds of AGI by 2028 and 90% by 2040, a forecast he says he has "roughly held since 1999". X blocked both links when I tried to open them, so I saw these words only in search snippets. I haven't listed it as a candidate. A person checking can open the post directly: https://x.com/ShaneLegg/status/1430146229426692097. If it's confirmed, it qualifies for 2021: it was posted that year, it's about AGI and it names dates. It restates an old forecast, but the wording itself is from 2021.
- **Not 2021:** His "around 2030-ish … 50-50 chance" comment is from the DeepMind podcast episode "The road to AGI", which the LessWrong page I opened dates to 15 February 2022. Most other results were about his 2023 interview with Dwarkesh Patel or later news.
